units.rawText: Burbank Sector's Core Plaza—Freestyle Performance District.
units.displayText: Burbank Sector's Core Plaza—Freestyle Performance District.

spans.text: Burbank Sector's Core Plaza—Freestyle Performance District.

units.rawText: Everyone, welcome to Kuro's Lightning Fever Stream~ Today, our opponent will still be the Burbank Sector's very own slave-to-the-rules, Reverence!
units.displayText: Everyone, welcome to Kuro's Lightning Fever Stream~ Today, our opponent will still be the Burbank Sector's very own slave-to-the-rules, Reverence!

spans.text: Everyone, welcome to Kuro's Lightning Fever Stream~ Today, our opponent will still be the Burbank Sector's very own slave-to-the-rules, Reverence!

units.rawText: (Sighs) Doing streams and beating up Sanctifiers, the life of Miss Burbank is sooo boring and dry.
units.displayText: (Sighs) Doing streams and beating up Sanctifiers, the life of Miss Burbank is sooo boring and dry.

spans.text: (Sighs) Doing streams and beating up Sanctifiers, the life of Miss Burbank is sooo boring and dry.

units.rawText: (Pants) I have to hand it to you, Miss Kuro... I can't believe you can say all this while fighting...
units.displayText: (Pants) I have to hand it to you, Miss Kuro... I can't believe you can say all this while fighting...

spans.text: (Pants) I have to hand it to you, Miss Kuro... I can't believe you can say all this while fighting...

units.rawText: Well, whose fault is it that Reverence is so weak? She keeps coming at me even after I've taken her down so many times. (Yawns) I'm getting tired of this.
units.displayText: Well, whose fault is it that Reverence is so weak? She keeps coming at me even after I've taken her down so many times. (Yawns) I'm getting tired of this.

spans.text: Well, whose fault is it that Reverence is so weak? She keeps coming at me even after I've taken her down so many times. (Yawns) I'm getting tired of this.

units.rawText: Is that all an Intermediate Sanctifier can do? Bring on the Greater ones, I say...
units.displayText: Is that all an Intermediate Sanctifier can do? Bring on the Greater ones, I say...

spans.text: Is that all an Intermediate Sanctifier can do? Bring on the Greater ones, I say...

units.rawText: Please don't say that! Intermediate Sanctifiers are scary enough as it is. There's no telling how much more frightening the Greater Sanctifiers are!
units.displayText: Please don't say that! Intermediate Sanctifiers are scary enough as it is. There's no telling how much more frightening the Greater Sanctifiers are!

spans.text: Please don't say that! Intermediate Sanctifiers are scary enough as it is. There's no telling how much more frightening the Greater Sanctifiers are!

units.rawText: Reverence suddenly closes in on Nana.
units.displayText: Reverence suddenly closes in on Nana.

spans.text: Reverence suddenly closes in on Nana.

units.rawText: Oh, I see you have enough free time on your hands for chit-chat!
units.displayText: Oh, I see you have enough free time on your hands for chit-chat!

spans.text: Oh, I see you have enough free time on your hands for chit-chat!

units.rawText: Eh, when did she get so close...
units.displayText: Eh, when did she get so close...

spans.text: Eh, when did she get so close...

units.rawText: Just as Nana is about to be smacked away by Reverence, the orb-shaped streaming studio suddenly flies in and knocks away Reverence's greataxe.
units.displayText: Just as Nana is about to be smacked away by Reverence, the orb-shaped streaming studio suddenly flies in and knocks away Reverence's greataxe.

spans.text: Just as Nana is about to be smacked away by Reverence, the orb-shaped streaming studio suddenly flies in and knocks away Reverence's greataxe.

units.rawText: Kuro reaches out to grab Nana's hand and pulls her into the streaming studio.
units.displayText: Kuro reaches out to grab Nana's hand and pulls her into the streaming studio.

spans.text: Kuro reaches out to grab Nana's hand and pulls her into the streaming studio.

units.rawText: Whew, that was close.
units.displayText: Whew, that was close.

spans.text: Whew, that was close.

units.rawText: If not for my decisive action, Nana would have been knocked out of bounds! Why don't you sing us a hot single by Nanaka to celebrate?
units.displayText: If not for my decisive action, Nana would have been knocked out of bounds! Why don't you sing us a hot single by Nanaka to celebrate?

spans.text: If not for my decisive action, Nana would have been knocked out of bounds! Why don't you sing us a hot single by Nanaka to celebrate?

units.rawText: Miss Kuro, you're amazing!
units.displayText: Miss Kuro, you're amazing!

spans.text: Miss Kuro, you're amazing!

units.rawText: Welp, that's just what it takes to be the World's Number One! If I hadn't covered for you back then, you'd have bought it.
units.displayText: Welp, that's just what it takes to be the World's Number One! If I hadn't covered for you back then, you'd have bought it.

spans.text: Welp, that's just what it takes to be the World's Number One! If I hadn't covered for you back then, you'd have bought it.

units.rawText: Alright, buckle up. It's time to begin.
units.displayText: Alright, buckle up. It's time to begin.

spans.text: Alright, buckle up. It's time to begin.

units.rawText: Okay, I'll do my... whoa!
units.displayText: Okay, I'll do my... whoa!

spans.text: Okay, I'll do my... whoa!

units.rawText: Before Nana can finish, Kuro throws the streaming studio into a barrel roll to the side to avoid a spinning slash from Reverence.
units.displayText: Before Nana can finish, Kuro throws the streaming studio into a barrel roll to the side to avoid a spinning slash from Reverence.

spans.text: Before Nana can finish, Kuro throws the streaming studio into a barrel roll to the side to avoid a spinning slash from Reverence.

units.rawText: Watch this, use Boost Submarine!
units.displayText: Watch this, use Boost Submarine!

spans.text: Watch this, use Boost Submarine!

units.rawText: Just as the streaming studio is about to sink under the surface, Reverence's axe excavates it and flings it out of the ground.
units.displayText: Just as the streaming studio is about to sink under the surface, Reverence's axe excavates it and flings it out of the ground.

spans.text: Just as the streaming studio is about to sink under the surface, Reverence's axe excavates it and flings it out of the ground.

units.rawText: Still got the time to hit on girls when you can't even go underground?
units.displayText: Still got the time to hit on girls when you can't even go underground?

spans.text: Still got the time to hit on girls when you can't even go underground?

units.rawText: Why are you dragging along such a weak agent? Trying to make my job easier, eh?
units.displayText: Why are you dragging along such a weak agent? Trying to make my job easier, eh?

spans.text: Why are you dragging along such a weak agent? Trying to make my job easier, eh?

units.rawText: Hey, I'm PROTECTING her, you know! Don't you know that protecting someone else buffs your damage and crit rate?
units.displayText: Hey, I'm PROTECTING her, you know! Don't you know that protecting someone else buffs your damage and crit rate?

spans.text: Hey, I'm PROTECTING her, you know! Don't you know that protecting someone else buffs your damage and crit rate?

units.rawText: Never heard of it. All I know is that justice is invincible, and people who talk too much get beaten up and cleansed.
units.displayText: Never heard of it. All I know is that justice is invincible, and people who talk too much get beaten up and cleansed.

spans.text: Never heard of it. All I know is that justice is invincible, and people who talk too much get beaten up and cleansed.

units.rawText: That's why they say Sanctifiers are so boring. As Confucius once said, peasants learn manners first before learning how to be officials, while it's the other way round for nobles...
units.displayText: That's why they say Sanctifiers are so boring. As Confucius once said, peasants learn manners first before learning how to be officials, while it's the other way round for nobles...

spans.text: That's why they say Sanctifiers are so boring. As Confucius once said, peasants learn manners first before learning how to be officials, while it's the other way round for nobles...

units.rawText: Kuro prattles on as she pulls the streaming studio's joystick, and the studio climbs straight up.
units.displayText: Kuro prattles on as she pulls the streaming studio's joystick, and the studio climbs straight up.

spans.text: Kuro prattles on as she pulls the streaming studio's joystick, and the studio climbs straight up.

units.rawText: The axe's blade scrapes the side of the studio and shaves off a chunk of its metal hull.
units.displayText: The axe's blade scrapes the side of the studio and shaves off a chunk of its metal hull.

spans.text: The axe's blade scrapes the side of the studio and shaves off a chunk of its metal hull.

units.rawText: Holy crap, that scared the hell out of me. My delicate, fragile core nearly jumped out of my chest!
units.displayText: Holy crap, that scared the hell out of me. My delicate, fragile core nearly jumped out of my chest!

spans.text: Holy crap, that scared the hell out of me. My delicate, fragile core nearly jumped out of my chest!

units.rawText: What does that core of yours do besides causing trouble for Sanctifiers?
units.displayText: What does that core of yours do besides causing trouble for Sanctifiers?

spans.text: What does that core of yours do besides causing trouble for Sanctifiers?

units.rawText: It can dummy-link Dolls too, but I bet you don't know that.
units.displayText: It can dummy-link Dolls too, but I bet you don't know that.

spans.text: It can dummy-link Dolls too, but I bet you don't know that.

units.rawText: Dummy-linking Dolls? What's that?
units.displayText: Dummy-linking Dolls? What's that?

spans.text: Dummy-linking Dolls? What's that?

units.rawText: It's an IRL thing.
units.displayText: It's an IRL thing.

spans.text: It's an IRL thing.

units.rawText: Kuro's Fun Fact Corner—Dummy-linking refers to the procedure of connecting Dummies of the same model to a Doll to improve her performance in combat.
units.displayText: Kuro's Fun Fact Corner—Dummy-linking refers to the procedure of connecting Dummies of the same model to a Doll to improve her performance in combat.

spans.text: Kuro's Fun Fact Corner—Dummy-linking refers to the procedure of connecting Dummies of the same model to a Doll to improve her performance in combat.

units.rawText: What kind of useless info is that!?
units.displayText: What kind of useless info is that!?

spans.text: What kind of useless info is that!?

units.rawText: In other words... <size=44>HAVE A KURO KNUCKLE SANDWICH!</size>
units.displayText: In other words... HAVE A KURO KNUCKLE SANDWICH!

spans.text: In other words...
HAVE A KURO KNUCKLE SANDWICH!

units.rawText: At Kuro's elated signal, Nana squeezes her eyes shut and hits the button beside her hand.
units.displayText: At Kuro's elated signal, Nana squeezes her eyes shut and hits the button beside her hand.

spans.text: At Kuro's elated signal, Nana squeezes her eyes shut and hits the button beside her hand.

units.rawText: Operands from her boosts gather into a massive fist, which crashes down on Reverence!
units.displayText: Operands from her boosts gather into a massive fist, which crashes down on Reverence!
